Drum/Stack base revision: cdedc35385 (main inspected 2026-09-08)
Chiptune Lead, SIP/chords and Sample VIB reference revision:
e725fb705d21036845dec5d0563206971eec3cb1 (inspected 2026-09-15)
License: BSD-3-Clause; see LICENSE and source copyright headers.

Imported Drum, Stack, and Chiptune Lead DSP, envelope helpers, lookup-table generators and
tools/copingSynth/generate_wavetables.py. No audio samples or GM bank included.

NullPerator adaptations: native fixed-point include; natural voice alignment;
correct frequency multiply/shift and signed lookup addressing; terminating
envelopes; explicit idle silence; bipolar drum output; functioning brightness
mip selection; retrigger handling; removal of logging from the audio path.

Wave tables: regenerate with
python3 tools/copingSynth/generate_wavetables.py sources/Externals/copingSynth/StackInstrument/StackWavetables.generated.h

Lead adaptations: isolated per-instrument voices; bounded modulation math;
bipolar output; explicit stop/idle handling; terminating attack/decay; immediate
zero-duration commands; consistent pan direction; fast arpeggio updates; no
logging in audio callbacks. Stack ARP/VIB/PAN/PSL/LEG/PFT were upstream stubs;
NullPerator implements them alongside the ported SIP and chord commands.
Sample VIB advances only at the sample control rate, independent of tempo.
Command and parameter IDs are appended to NullPerator's existing enum, not
copied from copingTracker. No Phrase volume column was imported.
